notes: NEW collection (added 2026-11-03, sounds library; judgment call J13). The client implementation strictly requires structured metadata storage for owner-added sounds: the live store reads/writes this collection directly (listSounds / addSound / deleteSound). The built-in catalog is an empty client-side array; all owner-added sounds live here.
Reads are public (read any on every document) so any viewer can list and play catalog sounds. Updates/deletes are team:admins only via the document template.

R7 SUPERSEDED (owner decision 2026-11-03 ~23:35): "users CAN add sounds, direct-to-library, NO admin approval; violations removed via report + strike." Any signed-in user creating sounds rows is now INTENTIONAL, not a residual risk: create-sound (signed-in) writes rows directly live with source_type "user" ("admin" for team staff), and the old R7 note is superseded — do NOT "fix" it by restricting creation. Removal is via report-sound + staff remove-sound, which flips status to "removed" instead of deleting the row/file.

ORIGINAL SOUNDS (added 2026-11-03): create-upload best-effort auto-registers a sounds row (category "original", source_type "original", video_id = source video $id) for every approved video posted with no sound_id. Dedupe is a video_id lookup before create (video_id_idx). video_id is deliberately NOT a unique index: many rows carry null video_id (library sounds), and Appwrite unique-index behaviour over nulls must not block those rows or reject the dedupe lookup; duplicates are prevented by the lookup, not by the index.

Audio files themselves live in the media bucket (mp3/m4a/wav/ogg, read any at upload). Deleting a sounds row does NOT delete its audio file; deleting a file does not remove the row. No cascade exists; the admin removes both by hand if needed. remove-sound deletes neither — it only flips status.

Honest content constraint: no naat/taqreer audio exists in the workspace. Rows must only be created for audio the owner owns or has rights to; Sound Effects rows only for verified CC0/public-domain effects with the license in source.

functions.combinationJustification: One combined HTTP function for all synchronous user actions sharing auth/team checks, vs 3 separate RPC functions + profile creation + moderation endpoints which would exceed the 5-function Free budget. Cost: single failure domain, larger bundle.

eventTriggersLogical.logic: sync-counters: count video_likes rows for video_id; write exact count to videos.like_count. Idempotent recount, never delta.

functions.name: create-upload

contract.flow: Client uploads file bytes FIRST to media bucket (owner-only file permissions), then calls this function with file $id (+ thumbnail file $id). Function authenticates caller, rejects suspended callers, validates duration/size/caption/location/visibility/filter/poll/duet/reply, verifies file exists/size via API key (deletes file on validation failure), creates videos document LIVE (moderation_status approved + published_at set, or draft if is_draft) with the live file-permission template (public read for approved+public), creates NO video_categories rows (category_ids removed from the contract 2026-11-03; any category_ids/sound/music field sent is ignored), logs moderation_events uploaded row, handles @mentions best-effort (skipped for drafts), returns created video document. No upload_url: Appwrite has no signed-upload-URL equivalent. Post-moderation happens afterwards via api moderate-video; nothing here gates publication.

validation.duration_seconds: > 0 and <= 20.5 (probe values re-checked here; determined client can lie about probe - same limitation as Supabase, strict server probing is a future upgrade)
validation.caption: <= 300 chars
validation.reply_comment_id: must exist; reply_video_id derived from comment
validation.moderation_status: approved for non-draft posts (direct publish, exact feed-query value), or draft only when is_draft=true. pending is never assigned to new uploads (legacy enum value only).
validation.location: optional string, trimmed, max 256 chars, null when absent/empty
validation.post_screen_extras: trim_start_seconds / trim_end_seconds: numbers clamped to [0, duration_seconds] (defaults 0 / duration_seconds); content_disclosure: boolean, true only when exactly true is sent; link_url: optional string, trimmed, max 300 chars, null when absent/empty. All stored on the video row by create-upload (2026-11-03 fix-up; shapes match the demo store).
validation.category_ids: REMOVED from the contract (2026-11-03). Sent values are ignored; no validation, no storage, no video_categories rows.
validation.sound: sound_id (string, max 64, opaque, not FK-validated), sound_title (max 80), sound_category (one of sound-effects/naat/taqreer/islamic, else null). Stored on the video row by create-upload. No music field of any kind is accepted or stored; any other sound/music/audio field sent is ignored. Catalog rows live in the sounds collection (see soundsLibrary).

notes: The ONLY video-creation path. No client collection create permission on videos.

functions.name: delete-account

contract.flow: Authenticate caller (caller deletes only own account). Delete user files (videos/stories/thumbnail files in media). Delete user documents across all referencing collections (explicit cascade; no FK cascade exists). Null reviewer_id/admin_id/video_id on SET NULL rows (moderation_reviews, admin_actions, moderation_events) instead of deleting history rows. Remove from Team admins if member. Delete Auth user via Users API last. Return {ok:true}. Partial failure reported as error; idempotent (already-deleted = success).

notes: Play Store account-deletion requirement. Deleting Auth user does NOT delete profile/content documents automatically.

soundsLibrary.decision: 2026-11-03 (owner order). Catalog-driven sounds library; structured metadata storage in a NEW sounds collection because the client implementation strictly requires it (see collectionAdded). Functions write sounds rows since 2026-11-03 (api create-sound for user/staff-added sounds; create-upload auto-registers original sounds). R7 superseded: user-added sounds are intentional, direct-to-library.
soundsLibrary.catalog: Built-in catalog is an empty client-side array (SOUNDS_CATALOG, deliberately empty: no naat/taqreer audio exists in the workspace), plus an optional catalog file at the fixed path sounds-catalog.json (app root; JSON array of {id, title, category, duration_seconds, src, source}; ships empty; loaded by loadSoundsCatalog in store.js, silent fallback to the empty inline catalog on absence/failure/malformed content). Owner-added sounds are rows in the sounds collection: id ($id), title, category, duration_seconds, storage_path (src), source (license note). listSounds returns the built-in catalog + catalog-file entries concatenated with sounds rows, deduped by id. Tabs: Sound Effects, Naat, Taqreer, Islamic (other Islamic audio). Original audio stays the default. NO music anywhere. Sounds are streaming-only: playback in the library/admin preview only, never exposed as downloads in the UI.
soundsLibrary.storage: Admin-added sounds are audio files uploaded to the existing media bucket (audio extensions added: mp3, m4a, wav, ogg; 25 MiB bucket ceiling applies). The catalog src references the bucket file. Sound files carry read(any) so any viewer can play a selected sound; the admin sets file permissions at upload (no function flips sound files). Server endpoints for catalog writes exist since 2026-11-03 (api create-sound / report-sound / remove-sound; create-upload original-sound auto-register). Live add = upload the audio file to the media bucket (read any) + api create-sound (or a direct sounds-row create from the client, which remains possible); demo-mode admin additions persist locally, client-side (localStorage data URLs, client-side 8 MB cap).
soundsLibrary.contentConstraint: HONEST EMPTY STATES. No naat/taqreer audio exists in the workspace and no copyrighted audio may be bundled or invented. Naat/Taqreer tabs stay empty until the owner adds audio he owns or has rights to. The Sound Effects tab may be seeded ONLY with verified CC0/public-domain effects, license noted in the sounds row's source field; as of this change no such seed is verified or recorded here — if the client worker seeds any, the license note must be recorded in the row itself.
soundsLibrary.enforcement: Selecting a sound does not change video enforcement: the 20.5s / 25 MiB limits apply to the uploaded video file in create-upload. Catalog sound duration is display metadata only. Per-video sound selection IS persisted: create-upload stores sound_id / sound_title / sound_category on the video row (opaque, not FK-validated). Post-screen extras ARE persisted since the 2026-11-03 fix-up: create-upload stores trim_start_seconds / trim_end_seconds (doubles, clamped to the video length), content_disclosure (boolean) and link_url (string, max 300) on the video row, matching the demo store shapes.
soundsLibrary.collection: sounds (see collections entry; 10 attributes, 2 indexes). Added because the client implementation strictly requires structured metadata storage for owner-added sounds — the contingency named in the 2026-11-03 sounds decision.

seed.keyHandling: Seed via Console (no key) or via a separate short-lived API key created by the owner, used on the owner's own machine, then deleted. The key is never shared in chat, never stored in files, never reused as the functions key.

judgmentCalls.alternatives: Appwrite relationship attributes (rejected: auto reverse attributes + cascade options do not match SQL FKs).

judgmentCalls.decision: Profile creation ONLY via api create-profile function.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Client create with collection permission (rejected: permissions cannot inspect attribute values, so role=user cannot be enforced).

judgmentCalls.decision: Category slugs are join keys; numeric ids 1-20 dropped; category $id = slug.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Document IDs '1'..'20' (rejected: opaque, unqueryable by name).
Single JSON string attribute (rejected: no JSON type; independent length caps; client reads plain fields).
Document permissions on profiles hiding role (rejected: permissions are per-document, not per-attribute; role would leak).

judgmentCalls.decision: Two buckets (media + avatars); no folders; name-convention prefixes; file-permission enforcement.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Three buckets splitting videos/thumbnails/stories (rejected: exceeds need; Free allows 3 but consolidation is cleaner and leaves a spare slot).

judgmentCalls.decision: Four functions: api router + events + create-upload + delete-account; one spare slot.
create-upload flow inverted: client uploads first, function validates second.
user_preferences kept owner-only; cross-user gate reads move into api check-allow-prefs.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Public read on preferences (rejected: private settings).

judgmentCalls.decision: Direct publish (2026-11-03, owner order): no pre-publication review for videos. create-upload writes moderation_status approved + published_at + live file permissions; publish-draft flips drafts to approved. Moderation is post-publication only (report + warning/strike, admin remove/hide via moderate-video rejected, suspend). Stories keep pre-publication review.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Keeping the pending queue (rejected: owner order, review khatam). Inventing a new live status string (rejected: feed already queries approved).

judgmentCalls.decision: videos.location added (optional string, max 256): free-text place name from the post screen, reusing existing visibility/comment/duet fields; no field duplicated.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Structured location object / separate collection (rejected: free text only, no extra storage needed).

judgmentCalls.decision: Sounds library (2026-11-03, owner order) is catalog-driven: an empty built-in client catalog plus a NEW sounds collection for owner-added sounds, because the client implementation strictly requires structured metadata storage (live store reads/writes the sounds collection directly; see collections entry). Admin-added audio files live in the existing media bucket; demo-mode additions persist locally, client-side. Per-video sound choice is stored on the video row (sound_id/sound_title/sound_category). No function endpoint writes the catalog. No music anywhere; Naat/Taqreer tabs ship with honest empty states until the owner adds audio he owns or has rights to.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Catalog data file only with no collection (rejected: the client implementation requires structured rows for admin-added sounds). Bundling/inventing naat/taqreer audio (rejected: none exists in the workspace; no copyrighted audio may be bundled).

judgmentCalls.decision: User-added sounds, direct-to-library (2026-11-03 ~23:35, owner order, SUPERSEDES R7): any signed-in user may add a sound via api create-sound with no admin approval; source_type records admin vs user; violations are removed after the fact via report-sound + staff remove-sound (status flip to removed, row/file kept). Original sounds auto-register from create-upload (category original, source_type original, video_id dedupe, never failing the upload). Category original is function-only and never offered in add-sound forms.
judgmentCalls.alternatives: Keeping admin-only creation UI-gated (rejected: superseded owner decision). Restricting sounds creation by collection permission (rejected: would block the intentional user-added flow). Deleting removed sounds rows/files (rejected: audit trail + stable references).

schemaGapsFixed.finding: profiles has NO verified column in any migration, yet 0003 public_videos selects p.verified and the app reads/writes profiles.verified. Shipped Supabase schema is inconsistent.
schemaGapsFixed.fix: Added verified boolean (default false) to profiles and public_profiles.

schemaGapsFixed.finding: Migration 0002 defines NO user insert policy for notifications, but the live store inserts notifications client-side (share/mentions/verification).
schemaGapsFixed.fix: Follows app behaviour: create(users) granted with cross-user grant caveat + api notify fallback. Flagged explicitly.

schemaGapsFixed.finding: SQL public_profiles view omits verified/private_account which the app reads from public-profile rows.
schemaGapsFixed.fix: Both included in Appwrite public_profiles; verified synced only by decide-verification.

schemaGapsFixed.finding: Followers-visibility videos are unreadable via direct query in SQL live mode (videos_select exposes only approved+public). Demo store diverges.
schemaGapsFixed.fix: Mirrored SQL faithfully; no follower-read permission invented. New feature decision if owner wants change.

schemaGapsFixed.finding: Brief counts 21 then 22 tables; migrations define 23.
schemaGapsFixed.fix: All 23 mapped + public_profiles = 24 collections; sounds collection added 2026-11-03 makes 25 total.

residualRisks.risk: Owner can tamper with own profiles role/verified/is_suspended via direct API call (no per-attribute permissions).
residualRisks.containment: Nothing trusts those fields; sync ignores them; file flips backstop suspension/verification. Full-profile reads limited to owner + team.

residualRisks.risk: Creator can flip own video moderation_status via direct API call.
residualRisks.containment: File-permission backstop: self-approved video is listed but unplayable; no moderation_reviews row exists. Follow-up option: remove client update on videos, route edits via api.

residualRisks.risk: Story 24h expiry is query-only; expired approved stories readable by direct document ID.
residualRisks.containment: Feed filtering correct. Future 5th scheduled function could close it.

residualRisks.risk: Moderators technically hold team:admins collection permissions where intent is admin-only or moderator-only.
residualRisks.containment: Role separation enforced by functions; direct-API abuse by a rogue moderator out of scope (trusted humans).

residualRisks.risk: Cross-user document-permission grants (notifications/reports/messages) may be rejected by Appwrite.
residualRisks.containment: Must verify in first live run; api notify/file-report fallbacks specified.

residualRisks.risk: public_profiles and counters are eventually consistent (seconds of staleness via events function).
residualRisks.containment: UI must tolerate staleness; never write counters/public fields from client to fix it.

residualRisks.risk: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-03 ~23:35 (owner decision): any signed-in user can create a sounds row directly, and that is now INTENTIONAL - user-added sounds go direct-to-library with no admin approval (api create-sound; source_type user/admin). The former risk (admin-only creation UI-gated only) no longer applies and must not be re-imposed.
residualRisks.containment: Violating sounds are removed after the fact via report-sound + staff remove-sound (status removed, row/file kept). Team-only update/delete permissions still stop non-team users changing/removing rows directly.

scope.demoMode: Unaffected. Demo runs on localStorage, no backend. This spec covers live mode only.
scope.noClientCode: This file contains no client code. Client changes required are described in APPWRITE_SETUP.md for implementation workers.
scope.noDeployment: Nothing in this spec deploys or creates anything in Appwrite. All creation is by hand in Console following APPWRITE_SETUP.md.
